integrity: A complete proof and standalone finite exact checker are included. Finite checks do not certify infinite quantifiers. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The prime-power generalized spectrum is already in Merikoski et al. (2025), §4.2. The proposed new content is the complete all-divisors multi-prime factorization, multiplicities, and exact inertia. Arbitrary GCD-closed sets are outside scope. Publication priority is not certified; independent verification has not occurred.
title: Complete generalized spectrum and inertia of GCD–LCM pencils on divisor lattices
